purpose: Verifier-owned bounded child protocol for mdast-util-to-hast named exports.

transport.request: one JSON object per line on stdin
transport.response: one JSON object per line on stdout
transport.stderr: diagnostics only; never parsed as a result

payload.args: JSON array with one or two bounded values

inventory.result: package-shape booleans and export-name strings only

request.json_value: null, boolean, finite number, string, array, or plain object recursively

failure.error_type: bounded exception class or adapter code
failure.message: bounded message without paths, stacks, timestamps, or environment dumps
